hero.description: Guided quad adventures led by a local team, across wild trails, Mediterranean light and a serious rush of adrenaline.

intro.title: Your adventure. Our home.
intro.body: For two decades, Quad Sousse Loisirs has revealed a different side of Tunisia’s Sahel: rawer, freer and always carefully guided.

gallery.title: Real trails. Real memories.
gallery.body: These images come directly from Quad Sousse Loisirs rides: our guests, our KYMCO quads and the natural tracks around Kantaoui.
gallery.mainAlt: Quad Sousse Loisirs guests lined up on KYMCO quad bikes on the natural Kantaoui circuit
gallery.mainCaption: A real departure on our circuit, surrounded by the landscape of Tunisia’s Sahel.
gallery.archiveAlt: Quad Sousse Loisirs archive collage showing quad, horse and camel excursions
gallery.archiveCaption: From the agency archive: groups, guides and adventure days in Sousse.

story.title: A local crew with a different energy.
story.body: Founded in 2005, our agency brings together deep terrain knowledge, experienced guides and genuine care for every guest. Our priority is a memorable, seamless and responsible adventure.

safety.title: Adrenaline never means losing control.
safety.body: Our guides assess the group before every departure and adjust the pace throughout the ride.
